text: Miramis's Galdr (Japanese: , Miramisu Sen'yō Garudora) is a Tyrant in . It is a Galdr machine. It can be found at level 57 at Boötis Reef in Volitaris.

The Milsaadi Spellslinger is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in . They are a Milsaadi Ganglion that can be found at level 39 in Oblivia's Jair Fortress during Route A of A Dish Served Cold. Although optional, defeating it rewards the player with new affinity links between Zo Zazhi and Zo Langra if they are spoken to after completing the quest.
Midnight Forest is a Nopon Grand Prix Battle Race Course in . It takes place in Makna Forest at night. This course starts near the Twisted Tree Gate and finishes near the Waypoint Beacon.
The Missing Drive is an Important Item in . It is collected at East Ibra Ravine in Oblivia during the course of Data Recovery.

Mika Kobayashi (Japanese: , Kobayashi Mika) is a Japanese vocalist and pianist. She is well-known for her collaboration with Hiroyuki Sawano for many anime theme songs. She is the singer of several songs from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack.

The Minor Chimera (Japanese: , Mainā Kimaera) is a Story Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Chimera family, and is fought at level 48 inside the Lifehold Core during Chapter 12. It can assist, along with the Major or the Mezzo Chimeras, the Queen Chimera summoned by Lao if the fight lasts long. None of these Chimeras are registered in the Enemy Index, except Lao as well as the Soldier Chimeras from the previous battle.
Moritz (Japanese: , Furittsu) is a Homs in . He can be found in the southwestern portion of the Residential District of Colony 9.

Mossy Panels (Japanese: , Mosu Purēto, Moss Plate) are collectables in . They can be found in Mechonis Field and Colony 6. According to their description, they are metal sheets whose exposed areas are corroded by the elements. Two are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In , they can be purchased in the Time Attack place from the Nopon Archsage for 5,500 Noponstones.

Mount Tortas (Japanese: , Maunto Tōtā) are enemies in . They are members of the Torta family, and can be found under Viliera Hill on Bionis' Leg at level 32. Two of them must be defeated for the Dadapon in Trouble quest.

Mystery Fireflies (Japanese: , Shinpihotaru) are collectables in . They can be found in the Ether Mine. According to their description, they are also called Singtings and the person who discovered them thought she was seeing things.

Monado Buster (Japanese: ) is one of Shulk's Monado arts in and . When activated, it generates a long glowing blade, allowing Shulk to cut enemies from a distance. The damage is doubled if inflicted on Mechon. Dunban is able to perform this art while he has the Monado, during both the Battle of Sword Valley and the Mechon raid on Colony 9. __NOTOC__

Monado Enchant is one of Shulk's Monado arts in . It grants an Enchant buff to all battle party members, enabling them to damage Mechon with normal weapons, and increasing the damage inflicted on Mechon by Auto-Attacks. Dunban is able to use this art while he has the Monado, during the Battle of Sword Valley prologue and the Mechon raid on Colony 9. In , Monado Enchant is not available to Shulk, due to the complete lack of Mechon.

Monado Shield is one of Shulk's Monado arts in and . The colour of the blade turns yellow when the art is activated. It then generates a force field around each party member, which blocks one Talent Art attack from an enemy, provided the enemy's talent art is not a higher level than Monado Shield. The level of an enemy's talent art is indicated by a Roman numeral at the end of the art's name. Shulk learns this art at the start of the battle with the Arachno Queen. __NOTOC__

Monado Speed is one of Shulk's Monado arts in and . The colour of the blade turns dark blue upon activation. Ether particles are generated through the blade and then transferred to the recipient. This increases the recipient's physical evade rate significantly, allowing the recipient to dodge the enemy's physical attacks at a high rate. The maximum evade rate is 95% for enemy physical Auto-Attacks; 90% for enemy's physical arts. It is learned before fighting the Mechon M71.

Monado Eater (Japanese: ) is one of Shulk's Monado arts in . The colour of the blade darkens and charges corrosive dark Ether particles. This allows Shulk to fire a blast at the enemies in front in a cone area. On impact the attack will deal ether damage, remove buffs, and inflict Bleed on the targeted enemies. Shulk learns Monado Eater by obtaining an ancient book from King Agni's Tomb. The area is only accessible by completing a series of four quests given by Lupa in Frontier Village, starting with Mystery of Makna Ruins 1 and finishing with Mystery of Makna Ruins 4. In , Shulk has this art automatically.

Mystic Dahlias (Japanese: , Misutikku Daria) are collectables in and . They can be found in Alcamoth. According to their description, they almost constantly exhibits yellow flowers and they are adored by the ruling family. Five are required for one route of A Dauntless Trader.
Monster Quest 3 - Part 4 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 3 Sono 4, Suppression Quest 3 Part 4) is a quest in . It can be received from a Homs resident in the Commercial District of Colony 9.
Monster Quest 3 - Part 1 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 3 Sono 1, Suppression Quest 3 Part 1) is a quest in . It can be received from a Homs resident in the Commercial District of Colony 9.
Monster Quest 3 - Part 2 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 3 Sono 2, Suppression Quest 3 Part 2) is a quest in . It can be received from a Homs resident in the Commercial District of Colony 9.
Monster Quest 3 - Part 3 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 3 Sono 3, Suppression Quest 3 Part 3) is a quest in . It can be received from a Homs resident in the Commercial District of Colony 9.
Monster Quest 1 - Part 1 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 1 Sono 1, Suppression Quest 1 Part 1) is a quest in . It can be received from a Defence Force soldier in the Military District of Colony 9.
Monster Quest 1 - Part 2 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 1 Sono 2, Suppression Quest 1 Part 2) is a quest in . It can be received from a Defence Force soldier in the Military District of Colony 9.
Monster Quest 1 - Part 3 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 1 Sono 3, Suppression Quest 1 Part 3) is a quest in . It can be received from a Defence Force soldier in the Military District of Colony 9.
Monster Quest 2 - Part 2 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 2 Sono 2, Suppression Quest 2 Part 2) is a quest in . It can be received from a Defence Force soldier in the Military District of Colony 9.
Monster Quest 2 - Part 1 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 2 Sono 1, Suppression Quest 2 Part 1) is a quest in . It can be received from a Defence Force soldier in the Military District of Colony 9.
Monster Quest 2 - Part 3 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 2 Sono 3, Suppression Quest 2 Part 3) is a quest in . It can be received from a Defence Force soldier in the Military District of Colony 9.
Monster Quest 4 - Part 3 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 4 Sono 3, Suppression Quest 4 Part 3) is a quest in . It can be received from a Defence Force soldier at the Tephra Cave Entrance in Colony 9.
Monster Quest 4 - Part 2 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 4 Sono 2, Suppression Quest 4 Part 2) is a quest in . It can be received from a Defence Force soldier at the Tephra Cave Entrance in Colony 9.
Monster Quest 4 - Part 1 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 4 Sono 1, Suppression Quest 4 Part 1) is a quest in . It can be received from a Defence Force soldier at the Tephra Cave Entrance in Colony 9.

Monster Quest 1 - Part 4 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 1 Sono 4, Suppression Quest 1 Part 4) is a quest in . It can be received from a Homs traveller at the shop at Ragrinar Canyon Path on Bionis' Leg.

This quest will expire after the decision to move to Colony 6. Monster Quest 2 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto 2, Suppression Quest 2) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from a Homs camp resident northeast of the pond at the Refugee Camp on Bionis' Leg. As with all the quests at the Refugee Camp, it will expire after the residents migrate to Colony 6.
Monster Quest 1 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto Sono 1, Suppression Quest Part 1) is a quest in . It can be received from a Nopon Merchant in the Nopon Merchant Camp, who gives four Monster Quests.
Monster Quest 3 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto Sono 3, Suppression Quest Part 3) is a quest in . It can be received from a Nopon Merchant in the Nopon Merchant Camp, who gives four Monster Quests.
Monster Quest 4 (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto Sono 4, Suppression Quest Part 4) is a quest in . It can be received from a Nopon Merchant in the Nopon Merchant Camp, who gives four Monster Quests.

Musical Genius (Japanese: , Ongaku wa Idai, Music is Magnificent) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Tati in the Nopon Kitchen in Frontier Village. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment. Once Musical Genius is accepted, Things that Hum and Things that Rumble are automatically triggered.

Moth Crawlers (Japanese: , Suntorimushi) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found on Bionis' Leg. According to their description, they are a source of entertainment for those who find them. Three are required for Collection Quest 2 on the Bionis' Leg.

The Monado Rudra (Japanese: , Monado R Rudora) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is one of the Replica Monados, and is only usable by Shulk. It is received as a reward for completing Replica Monado 1.

Mystery of Makna Ruins 1 (Japanese: , Makuna Iseki no Nazo 1) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Lupa at the Archaeology Centre in Frontier Village. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment.
Muscle Up (Japanese: , Butsuri Bōgyozō) is a Gem in that increases the character's Physical Defence, thereby reducing the amount of damage received from enemies' physical attacks. __TOC__

Mysterious Barnaby (Japanese: , Men'yōna Bānabī) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 75 in the Windy Cave on Bionis' Leg. It is in the small side cave immediately south of Windy Cave and is surrounded by numerous gigantic Pandora Pods which, unlike normal Pandora Pods, contain Envy Gogols.

Mysterious Noises (Japanese: , Mizukumi no Fuan) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Prox in the Hidden Machina Village on the Fallen Arm. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment.

The Monado Wound (Japanese: , Monado no Tsumeato) is a Secret Area in . It is located in northern Sword Valley, west of the Ether Storage Area. As the name suggests, this is a wound caused by Bionis' Monado.
Murakmors (Japanese: , Murakumo) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are swords wielded by Dunban, and are obtained from three enemies. They are not otherwise obtainable.

The Monapon (Japanese: , Monapo) is a weapon in . It is a biter wielded by Riki, and can only be acquired from defeating Bana during the quest Bana the Betrayer. It is the worst weapon by far in the game in terms of attack and defence, but the best in terms of critical rate besides the Monado III.
Murder Knives (Japanese: , Mādānaifu) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are twin blades wielded by Fiora, and can only be acquired from one shop, on the Fallen Arm.

The Monster Egg is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is required for for Secret Ingredient Hunt. It can be found near the Twisted Tree Gate. To get it from the elevated area, the party can go north from the river on Eks Watering Hole and then follow the path southeast.

※ After this quest is completed, Medi and Yusa may offer mutually exclusive quests. See quests Medical Advancements and Let's Make Fillings!. Mushy Mushrooms (Japanese: , Yawaraka Kinoko) is a quest in . It can be received from Kofuko in the armour shop at the Central Plaza in Frontier Village. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.

Mystery of Makna Ruins 2 (Japanese: , Makuna Iseki no Nazo 2) is a quest in . It can be received from Lupa at the Archaeology Centre in Frontier Village. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment.

Mystery of Makna Ruins 3 (Japanese: , Makuna Iseki no Nazo 3) is a quest in . It can be received from Lupa at the Archaeology Centre in Frontier Village. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment.

Mystery of Makna Ruins 4 (Japanese: , Makuna Iseki no Nazo 4) is a quest in . It can be received from Lupa at the Archaeology Centre in Frontier Village. It is automatically triggered after completing Mystery of Makna Ruins 3 allowing Lupa to make the Lubricant Oil.
The Mother's Necklace is a Key Item in . It is required for Search Quest 1 in Alcamoth. It can be found north of the Imperial Palace, halfway out on the northern bridge.

Mystery Girl Rescue (Japanese: , Nazo no Shōjo wo Sukue) is a Story Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received after finding a passed-out girl in the Contaminated Area of Makna Forest. When Shulk goes down to the Lakeside to find the Water Ether Crystals, a story event appears, Shulk is ambushed by a Telethia, and Alvis comes to save him and teach him another Monado art, Monado Purge.
The Monado Abyss (Japanese: , Monado R Abisu) is a weapon in . It is one of the Replica Monados, and is only usable by Shulk. It is received as a reward for completing Replica Monado 3.
The Monado Agni (Japanese: , Monado R Aguni) is a weapon in . It is one of the Replica Monados, and is only usable by Shulk. It is received as a reward for completing Replica Monado 2.

The Monado Dogma (Japanese: , Monado R Doguma) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is one of the Replica Monados, and is only usable by Shulk. It is received as a reward for completing Replica Monado 4.

The Monado Saga (Japanese: , Monado R Sāga) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is one of the Replica Monados, and is only usable by Shulk. It is received as a reward for completing Replica Monado 5.

Monado Armour is one of Shulk's Monado arts in . The colour of the blade turns golden yellow when it is activated. The Ether particles gathered allows Shulk to generate a protective barrier around all allies. The barrier will temporarily reduce physical and Ether damage taken (excluding Talent Arts) by 30% – 75% depending on the art's level. Shulk learns this art after using the 'Armour' Records obtained as a reward for completing the quest Stop the Mechon Rampage!. In , Shulk has this art automatically.

Moving Lizard Tails are rare material items in . They can be obtained by defeating various low-level Lizards and Wallslide Gwynry in Tephra Cave, or through trading with Leopold and King Squeeze in Colony 9. According to their description, they keep moving even if they get torn off and they stop wriggling after about ten minutes.

Musical Vanflare (Japanese: , Sangen no Vanfurea) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Vang family and can be found in Tephra Cave near Bone Corridor at level 93. On the map, it is at the northernmost part of 2F. It is the only Vang found in the game that uses sight as its detection type (since other Vangs in the game either have no detection type or use sound for detection). It is also the strongest Vang found in the game.

This quest will expire after the events at the Meyneth Shrine. Monster Quest (Japanese: , Tōbatsu Kuesuto, Suppression Quest) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from a Garrisoned Troop Machina at the Machina Refuge of Mechonis Field.

Murky Eluca Water is a rare material in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Perna Elucas, which can be found on Latael Shore at Eryth Sea during the day, or traded for in Eryth Sea and Alcamoth. According to their description, they are a liquid so insanely bitter they could tie the tongue in knots. Three are needed for Teaching Materials.

The Mysterious Droplet is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles, and is the object of A Final Sweet Favour. It is located in the water above Zaldania Waterfall in Satorl Marsh. Upon reaching it, Shulk and the party will be attacked by five level 62 Woeful Upas.

The Mushroom Cap is a Key Item in . It is a hat, presumably similar to those worn by many Nopon that are made of large mushroom caps. This particular mushroom cap belonged to Satata's deceased brother, and must be collected and returned to Satata for Satata's Younger Brother. Satata then requests that the party throw the cap from the Divine Sanctuary in Makna Forest for Rest in Peace. The mushroom cap can be found in the Mining Base of the Ether Mine.
Morule Hoxes are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Hox family, and can be found at level 23 near the Pod Depot in Colony 6 before the events at Mechonis Core.

The Mysterious Telethia (Japanese: , Nazo no Tereshia) is a quest exclusive Boss in . It is a Gigas-type member of the Telethia family, and appears at level 80 near the Lakeside in Makna Forest during Melancholy Tyrea. It must be defeated to complete this quest. At the end of the battle, it is revealed to be Yumea.
Monolith Software, Inc. (Japanese: , Kabushiki gaisha Monorisu Sofuto, MONOLITH SOFTWARE INC.) is a video game development company headquartered in Meguro, Tokyo, Japan.
The Music Box is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Nic during The Melody of Happiness, and must be given to Rosemary to complete the quest.

The Mysterious Sanctuary (Japanese: , Shinpi no Seiiki) is a location in . It is located on the seventh floor of Frontier Village. Dabidabi can be found on the diving board here, alongside a Heart-to-Heart - "Reawakened Memories".
Mollusc Mucus are common Materials in . They are dropped by Noble Brogs and can be traded for with Andreas and Dionysis.

Muimui (Japanese: , Muimui) is a Nopon in . He can be found next to his brother Moimoi south of the BLADE Tower in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. He is a member of the Curators Division.

Moimoi (Japanese: , Moimoi) is a Nopon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a member of the Curators Division, and can be found next to his brother Muimui south of the BLADE Tower in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles after BFFs is completed. After Setting Forth and Chapter 9 have both been completed, he moves next to the elevator platform near the West Gate in the Industrial District.

Myles is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at West Janpath Plain in Primordia. He is a member of the Pathfinders Division. He is a secondary client in Myles to Go. After completing the mission, he can be found in the Administrative District, on the path to the East Gate.

Mutually Exclusive Quests are quests in where one quest is associated to a second quest and the party will complete one option or the other. Indeed, the party will complete one quest and the second will disappear or only one of both will be triggered, so both quests cannot be completed, that's why they are mutually exclusive. A mutually exclusive quest can be triggered with its corresponding one and the party has to chose which one to complete. However a mutually exclusive quest can also be triggered without its corresponding one after having completed a previous quest while one of two possible routes had to be chosen, or after having chosen one Colony 6 Immigrant amongst two possible candid
Mumkhar's Claws is a rare material in Xenoblade Chronicles. For unknown reasons, it was cut from the game. It was most likely intended to be dropped by Mumkhar in Sword Valley.

Murderess (Japanese: , Mādoresu; English dub: or ), originally Sharon Effinger (Japanese: , Sharon B Efinjā; English dub: or ), is a recruitable playable character in . She is a Curator and a member of the private military organization BLADE.

Multigun is a unique type of ground ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X, exclusive to the Delta Bliss. It is a cross between a cannon, a missile launcher, and a rifle. It was part of Yelv's DLC in the Japanese version. Delta Bliss is the only multigun in the game. It is a level 60 ether weapon. Its FILE-R1306FC schematic is a reward for completing Yelv's final Affinity Mission Yelv's Partner. It is classified as a "Special Weapon" in certain menus such as the Scout Console. Any class can equip a multigun, and equipping a multigun provides its own ranged weapon arts (the user is unable to use ranged weapon arts from their own classes).

Molten Hollow (Japanese: , Yōgan Dōkutsu) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a cave on the north shore of Primordia, west of Northpointe Beach. Adolphus can be found here during Gold Rush.

Moorehouse (Japanese: , Moahausu) is a Human in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found on the stairs in the south part of the Commercial District in New Los Angeles at night. He is involved in the The Celeste Three Normal Mission.

The Morale Level is a mechanic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is also known as the Soul Stage in the Japanese version. It is represented as a three-bar gauge above the Arts palette with the HP and the TP gauges. It is somewhat similar to the Tension mechanic in Xenoblade Chronicles. This mechanic is linked to the Soul Voice mechanic. One bar of the gauge is filled whenever a Soul Challenge is successful. The more bars of the gauge that are filled, the higher the chance of a party member triggering a Soul Challenge. In addition, some Arts rely on Morale to get additional effects, with stronger effects depending on the number of bars filled.

My Dream (Japanese: , Subete wa Watashi no Yume no tame, All for My Dreams) is an Affinity Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received near the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles and the primary destination is Noctilum.

Myles to Go (Japanese: , Fusoku no Jitai, Unexpected Circumstances) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Satie near the East Gate in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. She gives the Repair Kit upon acceptance of the mission.

Molybdenum Xe-doms (Japanese: , Moribude Ze-raa) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Xe-dom machines, and can be found at level 41-50 patrolling West Ciel Sandsea (except during Chapter 9), South Silent Sandsea, or East Ciel Sandsea in Sylvalum.
Mortal Enemy is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Winged Viper at rank 3. Cross, Elma and Phog can use this skill.

Mortal Simius (Japanese: , Mōtaru Shimiusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Simius and can be found at level 48-50 near Keegan Ridge in Oblivia. Five must be defeated for Simius Smackdown.

Mortal Vespers (Japanese: , Mōtaru Usuperu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Vesper family, and can be found at level 31-32 in Primordia, in the entrance to the Molten Hollow.

Monado Activated is an Aura in and which enables the use of Monado arts. It is applied when the Activate Monado talent art is selected, and dispelled when a Monado art is used. It does not confer any buffs on its own, but can do so if Shulk has linked Melia's Arcane Aura or Telethia Killer skills.
Mortar Launcher Zigs (Japanese: , Mōtāranchā Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Zig machines and can be found at level 51-60 in Jair Fortress in Oblivia.

Mount M'gando (Japanese: , Mi-gando-san) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a large volcano located in northeastern Cauldros. The M'gando Volcanic Crater and M'gando Mineral Spring are at its peak, and it can be reached from the M'gando Gorge. The entrance to the Bestial Utopia is located on its slope. Lularita can be found here during A Present for Hope, and there is a level 5 Mechanical Treasure Box at the peak.

Multi Knight Qmoevas (Japanese: , Maruchinaito Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Qmoevas and can be found at level 21-30 in Noctilum, atop a stone pillar southeast of FN Site 215.

Multi Rook Qmoevas (Japanese: , Maruchirūku Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Qmoevas and can be found at level 40-43 on Lesser Anvil and on the broken rock bridge near Samuel Incline in Sylvalum.

Multi Queen Qmoevas (Japanese: , Maruchikuīn Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Qmoevas and can be found at level 41-43 around Lesser Anvil and on the broken rock bridge near Samuel Incline, and at level 50 around a Bismuth Xe-dom at North Silent Sandsea in Sylvalum.
Multi-speckled Ladybugs (Japanese: , Issententoumushi) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia. Six are required for Proficiency Exam 5.
Mosa Cabbages (Japanese: , Mosa Kyabetsu) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia.

Mondcherries (Japanese: , Warudocherī) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, in particular near the East Gate Plain. Five of them are needed during The Fashionista.

Muneria Flowers (English dub: , Japanese: , Myunaria Furawā) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum's southern landmass, south of Sapphire Carpet and Garden Spring. Five are required for The Mad Monk.
Morphling Flounders (Japanese: , Hirakamere) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum.

Multi-mirror Solar Drones (Japanese: , Tajū Kyōmen Taiyō Hatsudenki) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia, near the crevasse from the ingress. Three are needed for Supplies Surprise.
Moleworms (Japanese: , Main'āsuwāmu) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in caves in Oblivia. Seven are needed during the Normal Mission Oblivia Trailblazing 2.
Mya Oats (Japanese: , Myā Enbaku) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia, in particular near FN Site 320.

Mottled Mums (Japanese: , Madaraichijiku) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros during the day, in particular around FN Site 502 or FN Site 507, at Slavebird Isle, or near the Ancient Warscape during the afternoon. Two Mottled Mums are required for the Normal Mission Pack It In.
Muranadiums (Japanese: , Muranaadeniumu) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, around Mount M'gando. One is needed for the mission Definian Love.

Muscled Suid Bulges are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Suids in Primordia. This item can be exchanged with 30 Reward Tickets from the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. Obtaining them is easiest at Starfall Basin and West Gate Plain. Clearing one area and then fast traveling to the other will reset the previous area and can be done continuously. Suids appear only during the daytime.
Murky Potamus Waters are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Potamuses.
Mumun (Japanese: , Mumun) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Nopon and can be found at the Dorian Caravan in Oblivia. He is met at Lake Basel during the mission The Trading Floor.

Mother Forfexes (Japanese: , Mamu Pagurusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Forfex family, and can be found at level 13-17 at Cliffside Beach in Primordia during rainy weather.
Mortifole Mulching is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Interceptors and the primary destination is Noctilum.
Monoceroses (Japanese: , Unicoru) are quadrupedal creatures in . They look like unicorns with tapir-like snouts, and are physically similar to Progen.

Monoceros Colts (Japanese: , Koruto Unikoru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Monoceros family, and can be found at level 21-26 or at level 30 in Cauldros. A group of them can be found near FN Site 502.

Muruse, the Opulent (Japanese: , Kohaku no Miritsu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Blatta family. It can be found at level 56-60 in Noctilum in the secret passageway in the Vitriol Cesspool.

Mystic Saltats (Japanese: , Magitorī Sarutāto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Saltat family, and a group of them can be found at level 35-37 west of King's Falls in Oblivia. Three stand on each other's shoulders while a fourth sits in front of them. Some are replaced with Sorrowful Saltats.

Mold Caro (Japanese: , Mōrudo Nokkusu) are five Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caro family, and are fought at level 13 at the Scholes Battlegrounds in Cauldros during the Affinity Mission Hope Springs Eternal.

Mujiba Falgo (Japanese: , Mujiba Farugo) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 17-20 in Oblivia. He is fought at level 20 in Oblivias's Milligan Supply Base during the Normal Mission Kidnapped: Rada Valdileo. He is accompanied by the Meek Suid, but there is no need to defeat him, as he will disappear automatically once Mujiba has been defeated.
Multi-Wires are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Shrads and Galdrs. Three of them are needed during Material Hunt C.

Moving Thallus Tails are materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Thalluses in Noctilum or traded for 90 Reward Tickets. Three are needed for the related Indigen Investigation mission.
Mortifole Pollen is a common material in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Mortifoles.
Mystery Man (Japanese: , Shōtaifumei no Iseijin, Unidentified Alien) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from Professor B in his Lab in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.
Mujiji (English dub: ) is an NPC in . He is a Nopon and can be found at the Dorian Caravan in Oblivia.
Mogugu is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Nopon and can be found at the Dorian Caravan in Oblivia during the night.
Mondo (English dub: ) is a NPC in . He can be found at Division Drive in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

Mortar Gunner Zigs (Japanese: , Mōtākyanon Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 41-50 in Cauldros's Wildcat Fortress, atop the building closest to the Forgotten Mining Frigate.
Mortar Sniper Zigs (Japanese: , Mōtābou Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 21-30 in Cauldros, south of FN Site 502.
My Angel, My Lana (Japanese: , Mai Enjeru Rana) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Bubu on East Melville Street in the Commercial District.
Monoceros Wings are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Monoceroses.
Monoceros Hoof Hooks are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Monoceroses.
Mun'luarb is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is an Orphean.

Mon'barac is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is an Orphean who can be found at the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles at daytime, then at the Deliverance Park in the Residential District at nighttime after Herbivores, Unite!. If asked about recent developments after the conclusions of the mission in Deliverance Park at night, he will state that watching Naza assault Yun'tonam caused him to feel envious, implying he had some kind of masochistic awakening. He is not proud of this fact.

Mortal Jaculs (Japanese: , Mōtaru Hasutara) are six Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Jacul family. Three are fought at level 43 at Stickstone Rise in Primordia, and three more at Mount M'gando in Cauldros, during The Queen Is Dead.
Mujiba's Key is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It's obtained from Mujiba Falgo at Oblivia's Milligan Supply Base after he is fought during Kidnapped: Rada Valdileo.
Moorehouse's Key is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained as a reward after completing The Celeste Three.

Muimui's Meltdown (Japanese: , Nigero! Muimui, Run Away! Muimui) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Moimoi near the West Gate in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.

Murder Most Foul (Japanese: , Konpanion Akuaru, Companion Ackwar) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Ackwar, in a forced cutscene encounter located north of East Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles, between the two buildings.
Mollusk Mucuses are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Filiavents.
Moore is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Human who appears in Cauldros.
Mount M'gando Mineralogy is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request to obtain the Mount M'gando stone, which can be found in the Bestial Utopia in Cauldros.
Murra Master is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Dopang Caravan and the primary destination is Sylvalum.
Must-Have Blobs is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Nopon Commerce Guild and the primary destination is Noctilum.
Mustard-ing Courage is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located anytime at the Barista Court in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles between Phog and Cross.
Multicolor Murra Wings are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Murras. Two are required for Rainbow Wingtips.
Moving Vivohast Tails are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Vivohasts.
Moving Dilus Tails are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Dilus.
Muscled Cantor Bulges are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Cantors.
Monoceros A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a blue Monoceros variant with a golden horn. It can be obtained from Uluora, the Burgeoning in Cauldros.
Monoceros B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a white Monoceros variant with a green horn. It can be obtained from Alexei, the Jade in Sylvalum.
Monoceros C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black Monoceros variant with a brown horn. It can be obtained from Dawid, the Destrier in Cauldros.
Mortifole A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a golden mortifole variant. It can be obtained from Yessenia, the Husky-Voiced in Noctilum.
Mortifole B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a green mortifole variant. It can be obtained from Jindriska, the Serene in Oblivia.
Mortifole C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red mortifole variant. It can be obtained from Eliane, the Unmoved in Oblivia.
Mortifole D is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a white mortifole variant. It can be obtained from Katerina, the Cliffhanger in Noctilum.

Mother is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Nopon standing on top of Mother Fortun, the queen of the Definians. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Definian Downfall.

Multi Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Factory 1.21 Multigun. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Professorial. The only Multi weapon available in-game is Delta Bliss.

Movement in the Forest is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.5, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting eight Ovis. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Mystery Bird Herd is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.6, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting sixteen Insidias. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Murderess's Bodywear is Casual Wear upper body armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Murderess's initial gear when she is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Murderess's Legwear is Light Wear leg armor in and . It is manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. It is part of Murderess's initial gear when she is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Monica (Japanese: , Monika) is a Homs in . She can be found in the southern portion of the Military District of Colony 9.
Muddy Pelts (Japanese: , Doro yogore no jūhi) are common items in dropped by Armus and Arduns, such as the Baby Armu.
Musky Nectar is a material in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be dropped by Apis, Antols, or Elucas of the Makna Forest. It is also available by trade.

Mor Ardain (Japanese: , Superubia, Superbia) is a Titan in . It is ruled over by the Empire of Mor Ardain. It looks like a giant, metallic humanoid. The arm below Alba Cavanich is a mere stump. Since it is walking through the Cloud Sea, it is affected by the tides.
Motata is a Nopon in . He can be found at Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild's Goldmouth. Motata runs a shop called 12 Brothersisterpon specialized in Drinks.

Monell is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian salvager who can be found on the Deck of the C.S.E.V. Maelstrom, and later on the deck of the Ancient Ship. After Chapter 1, he can be found in the control room of the Maelstrom at the Argentum Trade Guild.

Morg Krabbles (Japanese: , Mōgu Kuraibu) are enemies in . They are members of the Krabble family and can be found at level 1 at Goldmouth Exit Dock and the Salvage Deck in Argentum. This enemy drops no items.

The Mymoma Playhouse (Japanese: , Bajena Gekijō) is a landmark in . It is located in the Entertainment District of Fonsa Myma, in the Kingdom of Uraya. It is a theater, where the troupe of actors led by Cole puts on plays, such as "The Heroic Adventures of Addam". "A Tora and Poppi Production" - a Heart-to-Heart between Tora, Poppi α, Nia, Dromarch, Azurda and Rex - can be viewed here.
Money-Bye-Bye are Board Game Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Hobby Trappers in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.

The Mor Ardain Consulate (Japanese: , Superubia Ryōjikan) is a location in . It is located in Torigoth in the Gormott Province, above the Galad Residential Zone, and is the residence of Dughall when the party arrives in Torigoth. There are no enemies or NPCs here.

Morytha Falls (Japanese: , Morusu Ōtakikabe) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Cliffs of Morytha, between Chehn Slope and Idora Cave. There is a Salvaging point here, and a Heart-to-heart - "Family Ties".
Morytha may refer to one of two areas in Xenoblade Chronicles 2: * Cliffs of Morytha * Land of Morytha

Mumuni the Littlepon are Literature Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Reedirait Bookstore in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of MOMO in her Imaginary Mode.
Mustard Kordeths are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Gryff Butchers run by Yofan in the Gormott Province's Torigoth.
Musical Hair Clasps are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Boldarde Textiles in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Montecoran Dolls are Art Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Talmye Antiques in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Aegaeon.

Myrmidon Eugene (Japanese: , Katanagari no Edomon) is a Unique Monster in . He is a Driver and can be found at level 33 at the Eggle Jetty (Abandoned), WSW of Abandoned Excavation in the Lower Level of Empire of Mor Ardain. He must be defeated in order to unlock Zenobia's level 3 "Greatest Warrior" Affinity Reward. __TOC__

|-|XC2 = |-|TTGC = Muscle Branches are Tree collectibles in and . They can be found in the Gormott Province, particularly around Zeno's Deadbole, and can also be found in Gormott, particularly in Torigoth Village.

Mookah Flours are Flower collectibles in . They can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain, in particular from the Collection Point of the Old Industrial District, left of where the Tempest Pterix is perched (there is also a Treasure Trove with a Nopon Doubloon), the collection point of the Geothermal Plant Lobby, in the spot near to top right side of the building, and the collection point of the Disused Processing Plant in the Old Factory. Two are required to cook Pyra's Pan-Fried Tartari, and Gorg's Trial Starlit Tart during Follow Your Passion.

Mordow Blants (Japanese: , Morudau Barando) are enemies in . They are members of the Blant family and can be found at level 21 - 23 in the Kingdom of Uraya, particularly at Sternum Arch, Lake Varna or Farlaine Wells. Four of them must be defeated to unlock Gorg's level 2 "FAS", and Adenine's level 2 Slipstream.

Mysterious Part A is a Key Item in . It is obtained through The Riddle on the Wall and is needed to complete Uncover the Truth. It can be found in a Treasure Trove at the Hermit's Hollow in the Gormott Province, as indicated by the Torigoth Murals.

Mor Ardain Murals is an Info Item in . They can be obtained by examining the mural in the very southwest of Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain, on the lower side next to the bridge to the palace. Accessing said mural involves jumping across buildings, then jumping down to a platform that sticks out of the outer wall pointing towards the western wing of the palace. They hint at the location of the Mysterious Part B.

The Mysterious Part B is a Key Item in . It can be found in a buried Treasure Trove in the middle of the Brionac Occupied Zone in the Empire of Mor Ardain. It will not appear until you have deciphered the Mor Ardain Murals during The Riddle on the Wall. Level 5 "Earth Mastery" and level 2 "Keen Eye" Field Skills are required to excavate the chest, and level 6 "Lockpicking" to open it.

The Mysterious Part D is a Key Item in . It is needed for The Riddle on the Wall. It can be found in a buried Treasure Trove in the interior of the Isle of Sleeping Remains in the Leftherian Archipelago, as indicated by either the Indoline Murals or the Leftherian Murals. In order to reach it, a malign miasma must be clear by using the level 4 "Dark Mastery" and level 2 "Ancient Wisdom" Field Skills. The level 3 "Fortitude" and "Keen Eye" are required to excavate the chest, and the level 6 "Lock Picking" to open it.

The Mysterious Part C is a Key Item in . It can be found in a buried Treasure Trove in the Genbu Drifts in the Kingdom of Tantal, north of the Central Ether Boulder Skip Travel point, as indicated by the Tantalese Murals, during The Riddle on the Wall. The level 2 "Ice Mastery" and level 4 "Fortitude" Field Skills are required to excavate the chest, and the level 5 "Lock Picking" to open it.
Mysterious Part E is a Key Item in . It is given by Erebos when he is defeated during The Riddle on the Wall.
Mysterious Part F is a Key Item in . It is dropped by Relic-Holder Tyrannor when it is defeated for the first time.
Moving Boards are Treasure items in . They can be found at the Argentum Trade Guild by Salvaging at any Argentum Salvage Point.

Mogen Hoxes (Japanese: , Mōgan Hoggusu) are enemies in . They are members of the Hox family, and can be found at level 34-41 at Battlescar Cove in the Peninsula of Temperantia. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Floren's level 2 "Earth Mastery" on his affinity chart.

Moskel Rhoguls (Japanese: , Mosukeru Rōguru) are enemies in . They are members of the Rhogul family, and can be found at levels 35-37 at Bardina Plateau north of Battlescar Cove at the Peninsula of Temperantia. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Electra's level 3 Shocking Assault.

Moist Upas (Japanese: , Moisuto Ūpā) are enemies in . They are members of the Upa family, and can be found at level 43-45 at Bone Road on the Upper Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Ursula's level 4 Beary-Go-Round, and Aegaeon's level 2 "Water Mastery" on their affinity charts. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Nia's level 2 Merciful Heart.

Monochrome Muscaris are Flower collectibles in . They can be found on the First Low Orbit Station, in particular near the cave-in at the end of the highway in Elysium. They can be given to Pekka to grow the Ominous Ardun into the Relentless Arduran. Each one gives 2 points of progress.

Mossplashes are Tree collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya, in particular from the Collection Point in Fonsa Myma Port, by the dam, at the foot of the tree. In the , Mossplashes can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Mysteroes are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Leftherian Archipelago, in particular from the "Ichthyology" type Collection Points located in the underwater segments of the Orl and Lud Cloudways, or at the Ansel Hatchery.

Morph Orbs are Treasure items in . They can be obtained in Torigoth in the Gormott Province by Salvaging at any Gormott Salvage Point. They drop exclusively from red and white Treasure Troves. One is required for the quest A Small War, during The Militia's Request.
Muscle Slash (Japanese: , Massurusurasshu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Vandham's arts when using the Dual Scythes.
Muscle Uppercut (Japanese: , Massuruappā, Lit. "Muscle Upper") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Vandham's arts when using the Dual Scythes.

Motor Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be dropped by a variety of enemies, primarily in the Kingdom of Tantal, as well as found in Treasure Troves and offered as quest rewards. Motor Chips share their appearances with Battery Chips, Engine Chips, and Booster Chip. __TOC__
Moui is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found on a bridge by Tretl Windmill Plaza in Torigoth, Gormott.
Mopopo is an NPC in . Mopopo is a Nopon who can be found at the Nopon Camp in the Gormott Province during The Missing Order. She provides the party with the Delivery for Feyla.
Mylak is an NPC in . He is a Tantalese who can be found at the Sealed Quarry in the Kingdom of Tantal during the quest Partners. He is partners with Humhum.
Morca is an NPC in . Morca is a Gormotti who can be found in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Mysterious Note is a quest in . It is received upon finding the Note Fragment in the Acid Gullet of the Kingdom of Uraya. Completion of this quest is a prerequisite for The Riddle on the Wall.

Morythan Tablet 1 is a Key Item in . It can be obtained from Girogi at Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya during Adenine's Password. The level 4 "Extra-Ancient Wisdom" Field Skill is required to read it.
Morythan Tablet 2 is a Key Item in . It can be obtained from Rododo for free during Adenine's Password. The level 4 "Extra-Ancient Wisdom" Field Skill is required to read it.

Morythan Tablet 3 is a Key Item in . It can be obtained from Arecilion in the Library Philosofia in the Kingdom of Tantal during Adenine's Password. The level 4 "Extra-Ancient Wisdom" Field Skill is required to read it.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Movement Heal (Japanese: , Mūbu Hīru) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It restores up to 3.5% of the user's maximum HP every second while moving. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

Motty is an NPC in . She is a Gormotti and can be found in Torigoth Market in the Gormott Province. Once the party raises Gormott's Development Level to level 2, she will offer the Merc Mission Mannam Juice Delivery. Motty is a cheerful and hard worker, helping and selling Gormott's famous wood and wooden projects. She loves woodworking and is very knowledgeable about the local trees.
Mulba is an NPC in . Mulba is an Urayan who can be found at the Mymoma Playhouse ticket counter in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Mokumoku is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found at the Nopon Camp in the Gormott Province.
The Mount Driver (Japanese: , Monbura Doraibā) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . He is a Driver, and can be found at level 63 at the Olethro Ruins in the Kingdom of Uraya during Farewell, Good Friend.

The Mustard Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Farming Tech. It enables the purchase of Mustard Kordeths from the Gryff Butchers shop at Torigoth in the Gormott Province.

The Music Box Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Shipping Lane Safety. It enables the purchase of Conch Music Boxes from the Yafush Antiques shop at Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Musical Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Cuisine Researcher. It enables the purchase of Musical Hair Clasps from the Boldarde Textiles shop at Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Mughtal is an NPC in . He can be found at Nharil Central Plaza in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He offers the DLC quest Midnight Feasting upon installing the New Quests Pack 1 of the Expansion Pass.

Monich is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian and can be found in the Torigoth Relay Base in the Gormott Province. He offers the Merc Mission Rebel Purge. He is a soldier stationed at the base in Torigoth, but seemingly disappears after speaking to him to accept his merc mission.
Mololo is an NPC in . He is a reformed Nopon thief who can be found on Quattor Street in the Indoline Praetorium. Mololo gives the quest Indol's Teachings.

After starting chapter 10, collecting the unlock item from the "Expansion Pass" menu, with Finch and Zeke in the party and Finch's level 3 "Birdbrain", the quest can be received from Zeke after staying at Anastatia's in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Momoni is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found by Max at the Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild. After finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.1), he is added to chapter 1 of New Game Plus to restore the money one time. He will help when Rex is unable to buy an Abyss Vest or unable to send funds to Fonsett due to lack of money on-hand.
Mukkle Medoozes (Japanese: , Mikkeru Jerī) are enemies in . They are members of the Medooz family, and can be found at level 23-29 after Salvaging at Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Monabh is an NPC in . He can be found at Hardhaigh Dock, Lv. 2 in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Moks Elucas (Japanese: , Mokkisu Erūka) are four quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Eluca family, and can be found at level 33 at the Baldotas Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago during the quest Maiden Voyage.

Monono is an NPC in . He can be found at Starboard Balcony of the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province and is the only non-enemy character in the Titan Battleship prior to Chapter 5. He is one of the Twelve Brothersisterpon.
Morytha the Unknown is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the View of a Lost Time in the Land of Morytha.
The Mor Ardain Salvage Points are places in the Empire of Mor Ardain in where salvaging can be performed. There are seven Salvage Points in Mor Ardain.

Moordre Quadwings (Japanese: , Asashin Kurōdo) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family that are fought at level 60 during the Challenge Battle Darkening Skies. This enemy drops no items.

Mynah Medoozes (Japanese: , Main Jerī) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Medooz family that are fought at level 55 during the second wave of the Challenge Battle Tiger! Tiger! IRL. This enemy drops no items.

Monopon is a Challenge Battle Boss in . She is a Nopon enemy fought at level 99 during the thirteenth wave of the Challenge Battle This Year's Heropon. She is the final Nopon of this challenge to confront. This enemy drops no items.
Monado Storm (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using the Monado. This art recycles the motion of Rex's Diving Swing.
Monado Beat (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using the Monado. This art recycles Rex's Mighty Beat.
Monado Striker (Japanese: , Monadosutoraiku, Lit. "Monado Strike") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using the Monado. This art recycles Nia's Elephant Press.
Myron is an Ardainian in . He is found in front of Garagorm's Arch in Torigoth, Gormott, and must be spoken to during Stop, Thief!. Myron offers no quests or Merc Missions.
Molten Salsas are Veggie Pouch items in . They can be created by Crossette at the kitchen in Tora's House. This requires her "Ardent Cooking" Field Skill to be at level 1.
Mystic Slice (Japanese: , Misutikkuejji, Lit. "Mystic Edge") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when wielding Dual Swords.

Mungo is an NPC in . He is a Tornan medical professional who can be found at the Militia Garrison in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna. He is a strong supporter of Addam claiming the throne of Torna, which makes Addam quite uncomfortable. He gives the quest The Malcontent Doctor, after which his Community is gained. He must also be spoken to during To Cross a Desert.
My First Adventure is a quest in . It is received from Lyta in Lascham Cove on Gormott.

Morumo is an NPC in . He is a Nopon trader chairman who can be found at the Formide Shopping Ward in Auresco of the Kingdom of Torna, and directly oversees most business in the street. His Community is gained upon completion of A Rare Sense of Justice, alongside Macmac and Morumo's aide, Popolo. He is loved by those who work for him.
Mystery Talismans are Talismans in . They can be created by Haze at Campsites.
Moisturizing Bagels are Staple Food items in . They can be created by Mythra at Campsites.
Munchygrubs are Insect collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.
Motley Cobras are Insect collectible items in . They can be found in Gormott.
Murakmor's Flashstones are Ore collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.

Myrrhes Crustips (Japanese: , Mīresu Shuribu) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Crustip family, and can be found at level 31-36 at Coolley Lake, Seigle Fell and Serene Springside in Gormott.

Momimi is an NPC in . She is a Nopon who can be found at the Orem Storage Ward in the Kingdom of Torna, and she has big plans for using cryptocurrency to make her guild, Pyrithium, the largest of all the Nopon guilds. She gives the quest 100k in the Red, and upon its completion her Community is gained.
Mulaea is an NPC in . She is a Leftherian who is found in the Fonsett Residential Area of the Leftherian Archipelago.

Morrow Cobs (Japanese: , Tumorokkoshi) are collectables in . They can be found on the Bionis' Shoulder. According to their description, it is a vegetable that fosters positivity, and each kernel is packed with sweetness. They are Evelen's favorite food according to her report card. Three are needed for Evelen on the Edge.
Monado Unbound (Japanese: ) is Shulk's Level IV Blade Special in . The color of the Monado's blade turns light purple upon activation.
Mortal Storm is Adenine's Level III Blade Special in . Mortal Storm is also Adenine's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .
Mysterious Raiders are Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are Levnises from Colony 0 known as Ferrons. They are fought on multiple occasions throughout the game.
Mortal Bullet (Japanese: , Mōtarubaretto) is a Battle Art in . It is one of Sena's Ouroboros arts.
Multi Blast (Japanese: , Maruchiburasuto) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the War Medic class. It becomes a usable Master Art upon unlocking the class.
The Mysterious Enemy (Japanese: , Nazo no Teki) is an enemy in . He is the first Moebius encountered by the party.

Murmur Rise (Japanese: , Mūmuru no Oka) is a Location in , located in Millick Meadows. It can be found by heading north of Kamos Guidepost and going up the climbable wall. The Unique Monster Altruistic Maribel is found here.
The Myma Gate (Japanese: , Maimu no Mon) is a Landmark in . It is located in the Urayan Tunnels in the Pentelas Region.
